verdict.rationale: The evidence shows scheduled Python jobs (Flights) that run on a recurring time-based schedule. It does not show user-defined rules that fire actions automatically in response to events such as data changes, inserts, or webhooks. A time schedule is an adjacent capability and does not count as event-driven rule automation, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
